title: The Reading That Learned to Float

features.name: the-pages-that-learned-weightlessness
features.desc-on-touch: paper floats here without air to carry it; reading has become so light it has learned to rise; you watch words drift toward the sky like seeds released.

features.name: the-book-that-opened-into-sky
features.desc-on-touch: a spine rests here, binding loose; the pages departed long ago, following the reading upward into a brightness that no longer needs paper to carry meaning.

features.name: light-that-reads-as-it-breaks
features.desc-on-touch: the sun learns to read the shadows beneath; light becomes text, illuminating in all directions at once; you are being read by the dusk itself.

features.name: the-ink-that-remembered-being-voice
features.desc-on-touch: letters hover between symbol and sound; the words hang in the magenta air saying themselves aloud without needing to be read, only listened to.

features.name: the-horizon-where-reading-continues-without-ground
features.desc-on-touch: the study opened like a book and learned that reading was always about how light breaks through; here reading floats toward a brightness with no ending.

reverie.title: REVERIE — reading light in the open air
narr: you stood at the edge of the study and Katita held the book
open between you. the pages caught the last brightness. 'it's
floating', she whispered. the words were lifting off the paper,
rising into the magenta dusk like breath made visible. you read
with her without touching the spine, light becoming the only
thing that held the story aloft, and meaning learned to float.
